title: Magazine p. 45: Photo of Gemini-7 from Gemini-6 with bright aura (NASA S-65-65304)
description: Photocopied magazine page dominated by a faint photograph (numbered 12) of a curved, crescent-like spacecraft outline with a glowing edge, captioned "Photo of Gemini-7 from Gemini-6, December 1965. The brightness aura is a common space photo effect and often makes point sources appear to be surrounded by a 'force field' or an 'exhaust trail'. NASA photo S-65-65304." The article text below describes how a Gemini-7 Earth photograph (NASA S65-63722) was retouched to create a UFO image and introduces reports of UFOs following Soviet spacecraft.
